log_dir.description: Directory path where Nova API logs are written

nova_api_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the nova-api service (increase under high load)

nova_service_password.description: Password for the nova service user in Keystone

nova_api_host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the nova-api service to

nova_api_port.description: Port number for the nova-api service

nova_api_db_connection.description: Database connection string for the nova API database (use PostgreSQL/MySQL in production)

placement_service_password.description: Password for the placement service user in Keystone

keystone_internal_host.description: Hostname or IP of the internal Keystone endpoint

keystone_admin_port.description: Port for the Keystone admin API (v3)

rabbitmq_host.description: Hostname or IP of the RabbitMQ server

lock_path.description: Directory path for lock files used by oslo_concurrency

policy_file.description: Path to the policy configuration file

policy_default_rule.description: Default rule used when no policy matches a request
